_note: Synthetic transcripts only. Each case is a streaming sequence of text.delta values. clear_after (loops only) is the 1-based delta index at which at least MinRepeats back-to-back copies of a >= MinPhraseRunes unit have streamed; tests require a stop within a small number of deltas after that.

cases.name: exact_phrase
cases.label: loop
cases.why: one short phrase repeated five times

cases.name: sentence_repeat
cases.label: loop
cases.why: the same complete sentence repeated back to back

cases.name: stutter_one_word
cases.label: loop
cases.why: a stutter on one word long enough to clear the phrase floor

cases.name: filler_between_repeats
cases.label: loop
cases.why: the phrase repeats with hesitation fillers between copies; fillers are removed before analysis

cases.name: two_phrase_alternation
cases.label: loop
cases.why: a two-phrase unit (A then B) repeated four times
deltas: I do not want to go
I do not want to go
I do not want to go
I do not want to go

cases.name: loop_after_normal_speech
cases.label: loop
cases.why: normal preamble, then the loop; the detector must not be confused by the preamble
deltas: Hello there, how are you today?

cases.name: slow_loop_with_silence_spaces
cases.label: loop
cases.why: repeats separated by silent frames, which arrive as lone spaces

cases.name: near_repeat_small_difference
cases.label: loop
cases.why: four copies of one phrase with a single differing rune in each later copy

cases.name: same_sentence_over_and_over
cases.label: loop
cases.why: the same plea repeated over and over

cases.label: loop

The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

cases.name: repeated_question
cases.label: loop
cases.why: a question repeated five times

Why are you doing this to me?
Why are you doing this to me?

Why are you doing this to me?

cases.name: split_words_across_deltas
cases.label: loop
cases.why: one repeated phrase whose words are split across the tiny streaming deltas

cases.name: loop_after_full_sentence
cases.label: loop

cases.name: long_monologue_c

Next add the tomatoes, salt, and pepper, and let it simmer.
Serve it with rice or bread, whichever you prefer.
